name: Packed Voxel Cell Encoding
definition: Encodes a voxel coordinate (int16_t3) and a crossing axis (uint) into a single uint. Used to return the hit voxel from the ray marcher.
summary: Packed Voxel Cell Encoding compresses a voxel's 3D coordinate and exit axis into one 32-bit integer, enabling direct intersection and normal reconstruction without extra ray-marching steps.
